No key-bearing development bundle body retained. Response digests never authenticate client or prove execution by themselves.

Nonsecret exact source/lock snapshots and hashes.
Actual binary digest plus explicit source-correspondence review receipt, namedreviewer, bindingdigest and honest attestation limitations.
Publicgate rechecks every retained asset/hash/review/label/framebinding; never trusts an arbitrary cachedpassedflag.
No private MachO copies, rawbundle body, SDK or private runtime root dependency in public repository/CI.
